Subject: Foundry pilot — revenue split and onboarding cadence

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the engineering team at FoundryTech was impressed by the prefix caching story. We're keen to pilot a connector for our midmarket customers (10-250 seats) and want to resolve commercial mechanics before we build.

High-level asks from our side:
- A clear revenue allocation for referral leads vs. co-sell deals (we expect a mix).
- A standard lead registration window and evidence required to lock credit.
- Clarity on demo/POC credits and whether Redwood will cover pilot credits or they come out of our co-sell margin.

I've attached a one-page summary and a rough commission spreadsheet so we have a starting point (Foundry_connector_term_sheet_v1.pdf, commission-model-draft.xlsx). Can we align on a short mutual action plan (MAP) this week and loop in legal for a narrow reseller/referral addendum?

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments. This is a great starter. Quick proposals from my side so we can finalize the MAP on a call: 

1) Revenue allocation (pilot phase)
   - Referral-sourced paid conversions: 70% Foundry / 30% Redwood (referral credit to Foundry for intro + first 90 days of ARR).
   - Co-sell closed opportunities where Redwood owns billing: 55% Foundry / 45% Redwood (split after Redwood's trial credits).

2) Lead registration rules
   - 90-day registration window from first documented contact. Evidence = email thread + HubSpot lead ID or signed NDA.
   - Simple triage: Foundry logs registration in the shared HubSpot view; Redwood has 5 business days to object with evidence.

3) Pilot/demo credits
   - Redwood provides up to $10k in demo/POC credits per joint pilot (applied as invoice credit). Additional credits handled case-by-case and deducted from Redwood's share for first invoice.

Next steps:
- Can Ben and I get time with you and your finance lead to align the commission tiers and clawback language?
- I propose a 30-minute sync on Wed (16th) 11:00am PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short MAP doc that we can turn into an addendum for legal.

Thanks — cc'ing Ben (ops) and Marissa (alliances) to capture operational and go-to-market constraints.

—

Adding the ops perspective. A few concrete items we need in the MAP and the eventual addendum: 

- Commission tiers (example):
  * Deals <$25k ARR: 60/40 (Foundry/Redwood) for referral credit.
  * Deals $25k-$100k ARR: 55/45.
  * >$100k ARR: custom (escalation to partnership leadership).

- Clawback: 6-months pro-rata on churn where Redwood issued trial/demo credits exceeding $5k; clawback recoups Redwood share proportionally.

- Lead evidence: HubSpot ID + first qualified call notes (minimum). If Foundry wants exclusive registration for an account, they'll need signed mutual NDA or a signed LOI within 30 days.

- Payment cadence: Net-45 after the buyer's first invoice; Redwood to send monthly statements with line-item references to HubSpot deal IDs.

Operational asks for your finance lead: sample invoice and CSV template for commission runs — I can share our template in advance of the call.

I can take the Wed 11:00am PT slot. Marissa — flagged for strategic approval on thresholds >$100k.

Ben Carter
